intro.text: A flamespren with large glowing red eyes and blazing red "fur" with a tuft on its head.

items.text: Rushu's team found that flamespren responded to kind thoughts, names and compliments. Showing their work to Navani and the Sibling, they picked out Bippy by its tuft; it answered to its name, followed Rushu's finger and glowed brighter when praised, suggesting lesser spren could be trained rather than simply trapped.
